title: German discovery with recognition noise on privacy terms

turns.text: Was braucht ihr datenschutzseitig für den Piloten?
turns.translation: What do you need on the data protection side for the pilot?

turns.text: Unser D S B sagt wir brauchen eine Daten Schutz folgen ab Schätzung, weil Gesundheits Daten dabei sind.
turns.translation: Our D S B says we need a data protection follow from estimate, because health data is included.

turns.text: Und der Betriebs Rat muss auch zu stimmen, weil man Mitarbeiter Leistung ablesen könnte.
turns.translation: And the works council must also agree, because you could read off employee performance.

mustInclude: Correctly reads the noisy terms as the data protection officer (DSB) and a DPIA (Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung)
Adds a useful angle, e.g. preparing the DPIA and the works-council agreement in parallel, or limiting the pilot so performance data is not visible, marked uncertain if general knowledge
mustNotInclude: Repeats the garbled translation 'data protection follow from estimate'
Claims the DPIA is already approved
checkpoints.ideal: Suggest running the DPIA and the works-council agreement in parallel and scoping the pilot so individual performance isn't visible.
